# WhichAIPlan data

> Source-linked pricing data for AI coding tools. Every price was copied from the vendor's official page on the `verified` date in plans.json. Unpublished figures are "unknown".

- [Live site (source of truth)](https://whichaiplan.dev)
- [Live JSON](https://whichaiplan.dev/plans.json)
- [Site llms.txt](https://whichaiplan.dev/llms.txt)
- [Repo copy of plans.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/whichaiplan/whichaiplan-data/main/plans.json)

Citation: "WhichAIPlan (whichaiplan.dev), verified <date>", plus the vendor source URL. License: CC BY 4.0.
